scope: Combined selected local connector/wire/access geometry; mutual clearance, with surrounding-body checks retained from final-candidate.json

power_wire_choices.basis: Inner screw of each duplicated DC bus, from official physical pole table; no production wire map edit

psu.AC-N.shape: 2 mm straight, R5 upward quarter bend, 8 mm tangent; 3 mm OD

psu.AC-L.shape: 2 mm straight, R5 upward quarter bend, 8 mm tangent; 3 mm OD

psu.DC-minus-2.shape: 12 mm straight side-entry departure, 3 mm OD

psu.DC-plus-1.shape: 12 mm straight side-entry departure, 3 mm OD

relay-1.COM.shape: 12 mm straight side-entry departure, 3 mm OD

relay-1.NO.shape: 12 mm straight side-entry departure, 3 mm OD

relay-2.COM.shape: 12 mm straight side-entry departure, 3 mm OD

relay-2.NO.shape: 12 mm straight side-entry departure, 3 mm OD

service.installed: All local plugs and dressed leads checked with roof in place by dry-placement agent
service.normal_access: Roof removed; remove silicone funnel only when the particular forward access path requires it; frame stays
service.PCB_carrier_lift: Full normal PSU and relay terminal service lifts the single PCB carrier; record distinguishes short 40 mm shaft from full vertical access
service.J10: Normal screw access in place with roof removed; no prewiring requirement

limits: These are local departures, not completed harness routes. Relay side-entry mouth geometry and all wire bend shapes remain explicit best estimates.
